title: Nutrition, Digestion and Enzymes
summary: Autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition, the human digestive system and how enzymes work.
objectives: I can compare autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition.
I can describe what happens in each part of the gut.
I can explain how temperature and pH affect enzymes.
misconceptions: Enzymes are alive and get killed by heat.
Digestion happens only in the stomach.
